notes.content:
[u][b][h2]Changes in the Game:[/h2][/b][/u]

[b]ENHANCEMENTS:[/b]

notes.title: Patch v5.3.3
notes.content:
[u][b][h2]Changes in the Game:[/h2][/b][/u]

[b]ENHANCEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Lafaya UI Notifications
[*] New Layafa logic based on difficulty
[*] New Difficulty Mode named as 'Baby Steps' for players who just want to enjoy the story
[*] Story Viewer in Main Menu
[*] Timer within Game - Registers Best Time per Level [Will integrate with Time Challenges and Leaderboard System in upcoming Patches]
[/list]
[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the enemies lafaya kill points for Bomber, Shield Guards, Regular Guards and Kamikaze Guard.
[*] Fixed the Low Health UI for screen resolutions other than 16:9 ratio.
[*] Fixed the Abilities UI for screen resolutions other than 16:9 ratio.
[*] Fixed assets disappearing in Lab Level, BioLab, Section 1.
[*] Fixed boss office door animation
[*] Added guns drops in boss lobby area
[*] Added new difficulty descriptions
[*] Added new leaderboard description panel
[*] Review the Boss fight - Wave 3
[*] Fixed the issue related to cutscenes subtitles whereby the texts were sometimes hidden behind the character's picture.
[/list]
Thanks for the support and comments!
Link to our discord group: https://discord.gg/PZepsNyV
